text: The designer is not confident drawing with the current medium and cannot depict the cat's face, and further clarification on components, scope and communication is needed.
Pricing and cost targets were decided: 25 Euros per unit, aiming for fifty million Euros revenue with production cost at half the selling price.

The PM will summarize the discussed items and place them in the project folder, while the Industrial Designer will produce a working and conceptual design, and the User Interface Designer and Marketing Expert will specify technical functions and user requirements, respectively.
There is a need for better communication, and clarification on whether the design should be a multimedia control centre with video recorder compatibility.
